points.description: States a valid limitation of wireframe modeling, e.g. the representation is ambiguous / one wireframe can be interpreted as several different solid objects (or equivalently: it becomes messy/confusing, lacks surface and volume information, hidden lines cannot be removed). Equivalent wording accepted; any one valid limitation earns the mark.

Gives a brief explanation or consequence of the stated limitation (e.g. one wireframe model can represent different solids so the shape is unclear, or complex models become cluttered and confusing to read).
